description: This file defines the JetBoy class, a main activity for an Android game demonstrating the use of the JetPlayer API. It handles UI initialization, button clicks for game control, and key events.

classes.name: JetBoy
classes.description: Main activity class for the JetBoy Android game, managing UI components, game state, and user interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI components and links them to the activity, also retrieves the game thread.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles button clicks to start game, restart, and switch UI visibility states.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key-down events, passes relevant events to the game thread unless it's the back button.

methods.name: onKeyUp
methods.description: Handles key-up events, passes relevant events to the game thread unless it's the back button.
